newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys 15 diesel cargoes in tender for March.
newsitem.headline: India buys 15 diesel cargoes in tender for March.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) bought by tender 615,000 tonnes of high speed diesel in 15 cargoes for March deliveries, traders said on Monday.
IOC bought 14 cargoes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and one cargo of the 0.25 percent grade, they said.

Following the award, IOC issued another tender to buy two 40,000-to-45,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5-percent sulphur diesel for March 1-5 and March 16-20 deliveries, on a cost-and-freight (c&f) basis to Kandla on the Indian west coast.
The new tender closes on February 5 and offers are valid until February 6.
Traders said IOC awarded four cargoes to European major Shell. Two cargoes from Shell were awarded for delivery to the east coast at $2.94 and $3.04 per barrel above MidEast spot quotes, c&f.
One cargo for delivery to Goa/Kandla was awarded at $2.22 per barrel above MidEast quotes, and the other at $1.82 premium to MidEast quotes, c&f.
Other winners were French oil firm Total, U.S. major Esso and Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) with two cargoes each, Swiss trader Glencore with three cargoes and U.S. major Mobil with one cargo.
Traders said three 1.0-percent sulphur cargoes are for delivery to Goa/Kandla, three to Kandla and eight to Madras/Haldia.

Total's cargoes were awarded at $2.22 per barrel abovce Mideast quotes c&f Goa/Kandla and $2.90 premium c&f east coast, Esso's cargoes at 70 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes c&f east coast, KPC at 47 cents per barrel above MidEast
quotes free-on-board basis and Mobil at $2.97-premium to MidEast quotes c&f east coast.
Glencore's three cargoes were awarded at $2.15 per barrel above MidEast spot quotes c&f Goa/Kandla and two cargoes to the east coast at $2.98-premium to MidEast quotes c&f east coast.
The 0.25-percent sulphur cargo was awarded to Italian oil firm Agip at $2.97 per barrel above MidEast quotes, c&f Kandla.
Traders had expected India to take between 500,000 and 600,000 tonnes of diesel in this tender.
